Explain the example for connect help text

blocks.text: A field can have a short help message as well as a label. aria-describedby connects the field to that extra explanation.

Try runnable HTML here with a keyboard as well as a mouse. A screen reader is a tool that reads page information aloud. Test real pages with people and tools; one automated check cannot prove everything works.

blocks.code: Use the name shown on your club card.
blocks.title: Connect help text

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `aria-describedby` points to the id of extra help text. The visible label still gives the field its main name.
A label's `for` value names the input id. That connection lets the label describe and focus the intended field.

blocks.text: A reading tool can announce the field label and then its help text.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: The described-by value must name an existing id. Do not put the whole help sentence inside the attribute.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Change the help text to suit a different form.
